description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puwakdandawa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830122 (24/0331)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
